capabilities: Schedule flashcards and note reviews with FSRS spaced repetition
Create cloze, basic, reversed, multiple-choice, and image-occlusion flashcards inside notes
Generate quizzes and flashcards from notes with an AI assistant
Import and export Anki decks, media, and scheduling data
Track study analytics with charts, heatmaps, and retention trends
disambiguation: Not a collection of tutorials for learning Obsidian; it converts your own notes into flashcards, reviews, and quizzes.
extras: Explains an accepted Obsidian review warning about runtime domain assembly (caused by bundled Redux in Recharts, not an actual endpoint). Anki image-occlusion cards are skipped on import and not exported. Plugin is free and open source; AI features use the user's own API key with no subscription. Automated-review disclosures list every external host contacted.
intentEvidence: Instead of splitting your workflow across multiple study apps, LearnKit keeps learning inside your vault.
motivation: Flashcards were the starting point, but the stated goal was to connect notes, review, and long-term retention in one workflow instead of splitting it across multiple study apps.
problem: Obsidian is built for capturing knowledge but has no built-in workflow for reviewing it later, so retention requires separate study apps.

relations.evidence: LearnKit supports Anki import and export for decks, media, and scheduling-related data
FSRS scheduling in LearnKit is powered by FSRS-6 via open-spaced-repetition/ts-fsrs

requires.name: AI model provider (Google, OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, xAI, Perplexity, or custom)

summary: Study system that turns vault notes into flashcards, spaced-repetition note reviews, and AI-generated tests, with Anki import and export.
